result.instructions: Tools for Rex Software, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the contact named Smith and show me their details and last notes."; "List my current listings in Subiaco with their prices."; "Which leads came in this week and who are they assigned to?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rex Software data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rex_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. rex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rex_get_user_profile
tools.title: Get the signed-in Rex user
tools.description: The Rex user this server is signed in as: user id, name, email, whether they own the account, position and default office. Good first call. POST /v1/rex/UserProfile/read.

tools.name: rex_list_accessible_accounts
tools.title: List the Rex accounts the user can access
tools.description: The Rex agency accounts (account_id and name) this user can sign in to. A user with several accounts picks one with the Account id field when connecting. POST /v1/rex/UserProfile/getAccessibleAccounts.

annotations.title: List the Rex accounts the user can access

tools.name: rex_describe_search_fields
tools.title: List the search fields of a Rex service
tools.description: The field names a search on the given service accepts in criteria, each with its label, type and (for enums) the value list. Call this before building criteria on a field you are not sure of. Sorting (order_by) uses a separate list of sortable fields whose names can differ (for example name_last, not contact.name_last): set include_order_by to get it. POST /v1/rex/<Service>/describeSearchFields (and <Service>/describeModel for include_order_by).

service.description: The Rex service, for example Contacts or Listings.

match.description: Only fields whose name or label contains this text (case-insensitive). The big services have hundreds of fields, so filter.

include_order_by.description: Also return the service's model description, which lists the fields order_by accepts (they can differ from the search field names).

annotations.title: List the search fields of a Rex service

tools.name: rex_list_value_lists
tools.title: List the Rex value lists
tools.description: The names of Rex's value lists (the allowed ids for fields such as note types, reminder types, lead sources and property categories). Use a name with rex_get_value_list. POST /v1/rex/SystemValues/getValueCategories.

tools.name: rex_get_value_list
tools.title: Get the values of a Rex value list
tools.description: The allowed values (id and label) of one value list, for example property_category. The ids are what writes and criteria expect. POST /v1/rex/SystemValues/getCategoryValues.

annotations.title: Get the values of a Rex value list

tools.name: rex_autocomplete_contacts
tools.title: Find contacts by name
tools.description: Quick lookup of contacts by (part of) a name: returns the best matches with id, name, email and phone. Use the id with rex_get_contact. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/autocomplete.

search_string.description: Part of the contact's or company's name.

tools.name: rex_autocomplete_listings
tools.title: Find listings by address
tools.description: Quick lookup of listings by (part of) an address: returns the best matches with listing id and address. Use the id with rex_get_listing. POST /v1/rex/Listings/autocomplete.

search_string.description: Part of the property address, for example '12 Smith St' or 'Subiaco'.

listing_states.description: Only listings in these states, for example ["current"] (see rex_get_value_list listing_system_state).

tools.name: rex_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts (people and companies). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: contact.name_full, contact.name_first, contact.name_last, contact.email_address, contact.phone_number, contact.type, contact.tags, contact.interest_level, contact.last_contacted_date, system_modtime. To find someone by name, rex_autocomplete_contacts is simpler. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/search.

criteria.description: Filters, combined with AND: [{ name, type?, value }]. Only the in type gives an OR. Field names come from rex_describe_search_fields.

name.description: Search field name, as listed by rex_describe_search_fields (for example contact.email_address, listing.system_listing_state).

type.description: Comparison; default "=". between takes [min, max]; in takes a list; is/isnot take "Null".

value.description: The value to compare with (a list for in, between and intersect_*).

order_by.description: Sort, sortable field name to direction, for example { "system_modtime": "DESC" }. Sortable names can differ from search field names (rex_describe_search_fields with include_order_by lists them).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

search_state.description: Which records to search: active (default), archive or trash.

tools.name: rex_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by id (names, emails, phones, addresses, tags, relationships and the related properties and listings). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/read.

fields.description: Limit the reply to these parts of the record ("core" is always included; related data is "related.<name>"). Omit for the whole record, which is large.

tools.name: rex_get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: One listing by id (state, price, agents, the property with its attributes, images, related contacts and events). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Listings/read.

fields.description: Limit the reply to these parts of the record ("core" is always included; related data is "related.<name>"). Omit for the whole record, which is large.

fields.description: Limit the reply to these parts of the record ("core" is always included; related data is "related.<name>"). Omit for the whole record, which is large.

tools.name: rex_create_contact
tools.title: Create a person contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person contact in Rex with a name and optionally one email and one phone. Search first (rex_autocomplete_contacts) to avoid duplicates. Not retried. Returns the new contact id. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/create.

phone_type.description: Phone type id from the value list (for example mobile, home or work); omit to let Rex choose.

tools.name: rex_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one or more contacts and/or properties (for example after a call or an open home). Not retried. Returns the new note id. POST /v1/rex/Notes/create.

note_type.description: Note type id from the value list (for example phonecall); omit to use Rex's default.

update_last_contacted.description: Also set the contacts' last-contacted date to today.

tools.name: rex_create_reminder
tools.title: Create a reminder
tools.description: WRITE: create a follow-up reminder (task) due on a date, optionally linked to a contact, property or listing and assigned to a user (default: Rex's default remindee). Not retried. Returns the new reminder id. POST /v1/rex/Reminders/create.

description.description: What to do, for example 'Call Will about the appraisal'.

reminder_type.description: Reminder type id from the value list (for example email); omit to use Rex's default.

priority.description: Priority id from the value list (for example high).

remindee_user_id.description: The Rex user id to remind (from rex_search_users); omit for the default.
